name: The Cinderling
storyline:
A blacksmith, cursed and bound to an abandoned magical forge. The secret to crafting your masterpieces is rhythm! Forge tools, weapons and relics for eccentric customers in a dark folklore world all in time to the beat.

Cursed and bound to the magic forge Kaino is forced to work as a blacksmith and craft items for the eccentric folklore creatures of the world. By learning more about the creatures, their wants and needs Kaino begins to unravel the secrets of the forge and the curse.
summary:
The Cinderling is an immersive, rhythmic blacksmith and shop keeper game.
Complete mini-games and feel the heat of the cracking coals, work the bellows to push the flames and strike the anvil in perfect time.

Stay in sync with the music and lose yourself in the rhythmic ring of hammered iron.
Explore a narrative rich world. Get to know the eccentric customers and the reason behind their weird requests. Uncover the secrets of the forge. And break the curse that binds you!eries of the forge.
